# NovaCrawl component

`seo_extractor.py` is an unmodified, vendored component from
https://github.com/SArfrz/NovaCrawl at commit
`68c95079dfc005b38e5e78ac024bf1f53cbc6327` (src/core/seo_extractor.py).
The upstream MIT license is included in LICENSE. Only the extraction core is reused;
the bounded transport, robots policy, crawl queue and research logic are maintained here.
